name: English (30 Oct)
items: Peter and his mum go to Sunny Mall.
'Do you want a snack?' Mum asks.
They go to their favourite spot, Yum's Snack Stop.
They look at the menu on the big screen.
How much is a slice of pizza?
Can we have two slices of pizza, a can of cola and a bottle of water, please?
